body.p: Claims 11 and 13-21 are currently pending. Claims 11, 13-14, 16, and 20 stand rejected. Claims 15, 17-19, and 21 are not rejected and presumed to include allowable subject matter.
Claims 11 and 19 has been amended, claim 18 has been cancelled (incorporated into claim 11), and claims 22 and 23 have been newly added. No new matter has been introduced.
Below is a discussion of the 35 U.S.C. § 103 rejection of claims 11, 13-14, 16, and 20 and the New Claims.
Favorable reconsideration is respectfully requested in view of the amendments and the following comments.

Claims 11, 13-14, 16, and 20 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 over Chertok et al. "Iron oxide nanoparticles as a drug delivery vehicle for MRI monitored magnetic targeting of brain tumors." 2007. Biomaterials 29: 487-496 (hereinafter, "Chertok").

Claim 11 has been amended to recite the subject matter of non-rejected claim 18 as well as to recite that the method is an in-vitro method of detecting a disease component in a test sample take from a patient, where the test sample is tested in a sample holder. The additional amendment to claim 11 further narrows the scope of claim 11 to an in-vitro testing method. Therefore, Chertok fails to render amended claim 11, as well as associated dependent claims 13, 14, 16, and 20, obvious to one having ordinary skill in the art. It is respectfully requested that this rejection be withdrawn and claims 11, 13, 14, 16, and 20 be allowed.

Claims 22 and 23 have been newly added. Claim 22 is a new independent claim, which incorporates entirely the subject matter of claim 15 (which is not rejected), as well as the subject matter of the intervening claim 14 and the subject matter of amended claim 11. Claim 23 is a new independent claim, which incorporates entirely the subject
matter of claim 21 (which is not rejected), as well as the subject matter of amended independent claim 11. It is respectfully requested that claims 22 and 23 be allowed.
Although no fees are associated with the filing of this paper, please charge any deficiency or credit any overpayment in the fees for this matter to our Deposit Account No. 20-0090.
